generic_mods.name: Concentration
generic_mods.summary: Using it takes your full attention until your next turn.

generic_mods.name: Conditional
generic_mods.summary: Works only under conditions: usually / more often than not / occasionally / rarely.

generic_mods.name: Constant
generic_mods.summary: Always on; can't be switched off.

generic_mods.name: Contagious
generic_mods.summary: Spreads to anyone who touches the target.

generic_mods.name: Costly
generic_mods.summary: Costs 1 Resolve per use.

generic_mods.name: Degrades
generic_mods.summary: -1d effective rank per use for the scene.

generic_mods.name: Delay
generic_mods.summary: Takes effect after an hour or more.

generic_mods.name: Exclusive
generic_mods.summary: Can't be used together with linked Powers.

generic_mods.name: Expansive
generic_mods.summary: Zone can expand to Distant (+6) or Extreme (+12) Range for Resolve.

generic_mods.name: Fuse
generic_mods.summary: Set to trigger after a delay up to 24 hours.

generic_mods.name: Harmful
generic_mods.summary: Damages you per use: 1 / 1-3 / 1-6 points (half value with Regeneration).

generic_mods.name: Imbue
generic_mods.summary: Use a Self Power on others you touch (Resolve for big Powers).

generic_mods.name: Inanimate
generic_mods.summary: Living-only Power affects Inanimate beings instead (-4 for one Source, less for more).

generic_mods.name: Inanimate Plus
generic_mods.summary: Also affects Inanimate beings of one Source.

generic_mods.name: Independent
generic_mods.summary: The Power acts on its own like a separate character.

generic_mods.name: Item
generic_mods.summary: Comes from a carried or worn item.

generic_mods.name: Limited
generic_mods.summary: Mild / moderate / severe / nearly useless limitation.

generic_mods.name: Line of Sight
generic_mods.summary: Reach Extreme Range: +2 from Distant, +4 from Close, +6 from Touch.

generic_mods.name: Ongoing
generic_mods.summary: Damage continues 1 per page after the hit.

generic_mods.name: Overkill
generic_mods.summary: Targets double active defense successes; -1 HP per rank (1/rank becomes 1 per 2 ranks); that Trait's cap is +3d.

generic_mods.name: Overload
generic_mods.summary: Boost +3d or +6d for one page, then lose the Power.

generic_mods.name: Penetrating
generic_mods.summary: Halves passive defense ranks (max -6d), not vs Force Field.

generic_mods.name: Phase Shift
generic_mods.summary: Affects incorporeal targets as if solid.

generic_mods.name: Precise
generic_mods.summary: Targets get +2d passive defense.

generic_mods.name: Ranged
generic_mods.summary: Reach Distant Range: +2 from Close, +4 from Touch.

generic_mods.name: Ready/Reload
generic_mods.summary: -1: reload every 3 uses; -2: ready after every use.

generic_mods.name: Recharge
generic_mods.summary: Usable once every 3 pages.

generic_mods.name: Resisted
generic_mods.summary: Special effects can't be actively defended against (GM approval).

generic_mods.name: Ricochet
generic_mods.summary: Bank shots; 1 Resolve to defeat double Minions.

generic_mods.name: Selective
generic_mods.summary: Only affects whom you choose.

generic_mods.name: Shutdown
generic_mods.summary: Something can stop it: usually works / more often than not / occasionally / rarely.

generic_mods.name: Side Effect
generic_mods.summary: Annoying / harmful / catastrophic side effect.

generic_mods.name: Signature
generic_mods.summary: Obvious or leaves a traceable signature.

generic_mods.name: Speech
generic_mods.summary: Target must hear and understand your words.

generic_mods.name: Spray
generic_mods.summary: +1d at Touch/Close, -2d at Distant.

generic_mods.name: Subtle/Undetectable
generic_mods.summary: Subtle (+2) or completely undetectable (+6).

generic_mods.name: Sustained
generic_mods.summary: Costs an action per page to maintain.

generic_mods.name: Touch
generic_mods.summary: Requires contact: -2 from Close, -4 from Distant.

generic_mods.name: Toxin
generic_mods.summary: A disease/drug/poison; Resistance defends.

generic_mods.name: Trap
generic_mods.summary: Set the Power as a trap.

generic_mods.name: Two-Handed
generic_mods.summary: Needs both hands free.

generic_mods.name: Uncontrolled
generic_mods.summary: Activates or deactivates on its own in certain situations.

generic_mods.name: Unreliable
generic_mods.summary: Roll 2 dice per use; 6 or less fails.

generic_mods.name: Words
generic_mods.summary: Must speak aloud.

perks.name: Authority
perks.summary: Special rights or authority: clearances, immunity, arrest powers, nobility.

perks.name: Contact
perks.summary: A person who provides information and small favors.

perks.name: Fame
perks.summary: Famous and favorably recognized (one identity per purchase).

perks.name: Fourth Wall
perks.summary: Earn 1 Resolve once per scene for a fourth-wall joke that lands.

perks.name: Headquarters
perks.summary: A base of operations; Heroes can pool Base Points.

perks.name: Patron
perks.summary: An organization or backer that supplies support.

perks.name: Pet/Sidekick
perks.summary: A companion at least one power level below you; 6 HP per power level.

perks.name: Reputation
perks.summary: Credibility and respect in a particular arena.

perks.name: Resources
perks.summary: Access to a supply of equipment (not wealth).

perks.name: Unique Vehicle
perks.summary: One or more unique vehicles, outside the Gear Limit.

perks.name: Wealth/Great Wealth
perks.summary: Comic-book rich; Great Wealth allows an absurd purchase per issue for 1 Resolve.
